definitions.explanation: A person who has placed high enough in a contest or competition to receive a prize or award. Includes not only the top winner but anyone awarded a recognized rank or honor.

examples.japanese: {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
{入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}には{賞金|しょうきん}が{贈|おく}られる。
examples.english: Prize money is awarded to the winners.

examples.japanese: {作文|さくぶん}コンクールの{入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}が{壇上|だんじょう}に{並|なら}んで、{記念|きねん}{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: The winners of the essay contest lined up on stage and took a commemorative photo.

notes:
Compound of {入賞|にゅうしょう} (winning a prize) + {者|しゃ} (person). Refers to anyone awarded a rank, not only the top winner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}{発表|はっぴょう}: announcement of winners
- {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}{一覧|いちらん}: list of prize winners
- コンクールの{入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}: contest winners
- {入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}に{選|えら}ばれる: to be chosen as a prize winner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}: award winner — broader; used for named awards and prizes (Nobel, etc.)
- {優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}: champion; first-place winner — specifically the top finisher
